name: Nelie Bluespirit
original_name: ネリー・ブルースピリット
source:
"Now. I've gotta act cool"

Her sword is named 'Silence', but she is on the contrary quite lively. 

She's young even among her squad members, and the mood maker of the group.

Shiah is her younger twin sister.
